description: A small firm specializes in making some types of spare automobile parts. Each part has to go through several machines. We know the required worker-hours for each part on each machine. We also know the profit made on each part. Each machine has a capacity in terms of worker-hours. The firm wants to determine how many of each part to make in order to maximize profit.

NumParts.definition: Number of types of spare parts

Time.definition: Worker-hours required to produce one unit of part k on machine s

Profit.definition: Profit from producing one unit of part k

Capacity.definition: Available worker-hours capacity of machine s

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from producing the spare automobile parts"

constraints.description: For each machine s, the total worker-hours used by all parts on machine s cannot exceed its available capacity, i.e., sum over all parts k of Time[k,s] * x[k] must be less than or equal to Capacity[s]
The production quantity of each part k must be non-negative, i.e., x[k] >= 0 for all k

x.definition: Number of units produced of part k
